review_scope: Only rgbnt201_ranked_outlet.py and the R201B section of the priority plan; relevant existing parents inspected to establish descriptor, loss, sampler and update semantics. No builder or launcher is implemented or approved by this review.
summary: No blocking source defect was found in the declared smooth-AP objective factor. The code applies the intended label/camera-aware approximation to the actual fused full-view and partial-view descriptors, preserves the original losses and two-backward/one-update sequence, and introduces no model parameters or additional neural forwards. This is permission to continue preparation and actual preflight, not a real-math, native-update, smoke, formal50 or scientific-success result.
reviewer_context: Fresh delegated reviewer read the supplied local sources directly. Workflow routing requests do not attest the actual served backend, model or effort.

plan_reviewed.scope_boundary: The plan's historical top-level/R201A running-status fields are outside this narrow R201B review and do not establish current runtime state. The task supplied R201A completion and block-readout facts; this review did not recollect or recompute them.

mathematical_objective.similarity: s[i,j] = dot(query[i], gallery[j]) in FP32 on the already weighted/normalized fused descriptor
mathematical_objective.ahead: A[i,j,k] = sigmoid((s[i,k] - s[i,j]) / 0.05) for k != j, and 0 for k == j
mathematical_objective.query_ap: For queries with at least one legal positive: AP[i] = sum_j P[i,j] * Rpos[i,j] / R[i,j] / sum_j P[i,j]
mathematical_objective.loss: 1 - mean(AP[i]) over eligible queries; graph-connected zero if there are no eligible queries
mathematical_objective.interpretation: This is the explicitly defined smooth approximation in this source. Exact official Smooth-AP implementation reproduction and a novel-loss claim are not established or claimed by this review.

checks.requirement: Correct sign, candidate axis, rank numerator and denominator
checks.evidence: similarity[:, None, :] - similarity[:, :, None] gives s[i,k]-s[i,j]. A more similar competitor k contributes more to the rank of candidate j. The eye mask excludes candidate self k=j, and the final reduction is over k. Both ranks add candidate j once; numerator competitors are legal positives and denominator competitors are all non-junk candidates. The final mean is restricted to legal positive j and eligible i.

checks.requirement: RGBNT201 GT masks and no grouped-label assumption
checks.evidence: The code excludes all same-ID/same-camera candidates, including the same record, and retains different-ID negatives even when their cameras match. Legal positives require the same ID and a different camera. Masks use pairwise equality of the provided labels/cameras, without reshaping into P/K groups or assuming contiguous identity blocks. This agrees with full_evaluation.full_metrics junk semantics.

For the documented same-records-in-both-views interface, a common permutation of query, gallery, labels and cameras permutes both similarity axes and every mask together; candidate self, per-query positive counts and averaged loss are unchanged algebraically. Independent query/gallery ordering with only one shared metadata vector is outside this function's documented interface. Actual tensor permutation probes remain unrun.

checks.requirement: Identity-only PK sampler and ineligible-query handling
checks.evidence: RandomIdentitySampler groups only by pid and never enforces camera diversity; RGBNT201 config is B64/K8/P8. positive.any(1) selects queries with at least one legal cross-camera positive. A wholly ineligible batch returns similarity.sum()*0 with eligible count 0; otherwise no empty positive count enters the AP denominator. step returns full and partial eligible counts in its detail dictionary. The existing runner can persist these through its full-detail batch_orders.jsonl writes; the future R201B integration must retain that path.

SharedIdentityDeMo.forward constructs fused=metric_descriptor(base), places fused at output[1] in both full and partial training, and returns fused for evaluation. metric_descriptor concatenates sqrt(.75)*normalized private5120 and sqrt(.25)*normalized public512. OriginalAnchoredDeMo inherits this forward. R201B passes output[1] directly to both full-rank arguments, and uses the partial forward's query against the detached full descriptor. No block weight or descriptor dimension changes.

checks.requirement: Preserve old four-head/full and partial losses
checks.evidence: RGBNT201 DIRECT=1 gives four score/feature pairs and loss_weights=[1,1,.25,1] for fused, MoE, shared and direct-private heads. R201B retains the same weighted loss_fn call for every pair, then adds rank_weight 1 to the full loss. Partial loss retains .25 label-smoothed CE and .5 existing partial_gallery_triplet, then adds rank_weight 1. The new assertion deliberately targets the even-length demo_shared output; it does not silently drop an expert contribution term.

Full smooth_ap uses output[1] as query and gallery without detach, so both similarity arguments retain their existing differentiable paths. FP32 casts preserve autograd. Only the existing partial-gallery boundary uses detach, exactly as the old step; partial rank gradients reach the partial query. Full loss backward precedes partial forward/backward, followed by one unscale, one scaler.step and one scaler.update. zero_grad and optimizer-updated bookkeeping match the parent. The external scaler's AMP512 initialization is supplied by the existing official runner, not constructed by this module.

checks.requirement: No additional parameters, neural forwards, BN calls or encoder-state changes
checks.evidence: The new module contains only constants and the smooth_ap/step functions. smooth_ap performs tensor arithmetic and metadata masking, with no module creation or model invocation. step retains exactly one full and one partial model call, and never changes model modes, requires_grad flags, parameters, buffers, optimizers, sampler or random state. The fixed original encoder policy and existing FP32 base fusion are supplied unchanged by original_identity_anchor; the new full-rank path adds no detach to them. Runtime parameter/BN/anchor equality is still a preflight gate.

checks.requirement: Training-only labels and honest integration scope
checks.evidence: New losses consume target and cam from the supplied training batch only. No query/gallery benchmark labels, files or evaluation functions are accessed by the new module. R201B states entire official train, the same original E28 fixed encoder/interface and the same additional50/new-optimizer budget. No entry point currently wires the module to that full-data builder/runner, so these future-run settings are not claimed to be executed or enforced by the standalone step itself.

required_next_gates: Actual CPU math probes: well-separated correct ordering has AP near 1; one positive after one legal negative has AP near .5; same-ID/same-camera junk contributes neither a rank competitor nor a positive; joint permutation invariance; all-ineligible count 0 and finite zero rank term.
Actual autograd checks: finite rank loss and appropriate full-query/full-gallery gradients, partial-query gradients with stopped full gallery, and unchanged frozen private tensors/buffers/modes.

Implement and review the minimal fixed-E28 R201B builder/runner/launcher integration, preserving official3951/836/836, B64/P8/K8, sampler/partial-set sequence, four old heads, metric blocks, model parameters and existing AMP512/new-Adam/additional50 policy.

Actual new-loss native updates and independent Adam replay, then smoke with successful optimizer updates, active finite gradients, unchanged intended BN call counts/private anchor, eligible-query logging and strict reload, before formal50.
